description.en: This is a medical corpus annotated morphologically, syntactically and with 4 types of Named Entities from the medical domain: ANAT (body parts), CHEM (Chemicals and Drugs), DISO (disorders), and PROC (procedures).

sparql.title: SiMoNERo SPARQL endpoint
sparql.description: SPARQL endpoint for SiMoNERo hosted at RACAI. A query form is available at https://relate.racai.ro/datasets/dataset.html?tab=query&ds=/simonero
